cards.text: Paul writes this letter with Silvanus and Timothy, two men who preached Jesus right alongside him (2 Corinthians 1:19). It goes to the church of the Thessalonians. Three names on one letter, like the birthday card the whole office signs, except nobody here just scribbled "Best wishes!" and RAN.

cards.question: Paul greets the Thessalonians with grace and peace. Who does he say the grace and peace come from?

answers.text: God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
Paul and the churches of Judea
The apostles and elders in Jerusalem

cards.text: Then Paul says he and his team are obligated to thank God for the Thessalonians all the time, and that it's only fitting. Not once in a while, friend. ALL the time.

cards.question: Paul thanks God for the Thessalonians because their faith is ___ more and more.
Paul says the Thessalonians' love for one another is starting to cool off.

cards.text: Paul boasts about them among God's churches, and friend, I GET it. Get me started on my six cookie cutter kids, Chip, Sparkle, Minty, Berry, Buttercup and Ruby, and you will NOT get out of this bakery before the cookies cool.

cards.question: Paul boasts about the Thessalonians among God's churches. What does he boast about?
Paul says the Thessalonians keep up their perseverance and faith in the face of what?

answers.text: A long famine in the land

cards.text: Then Paul says, "All this is clear evidence of God's righteous judgment." Stay with him, friend, because he's going somewhere with this.

cards.question: Paul tells the Thessalonians they will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God.

cards.text: Now Paul talks about what's fair. He says "it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you…" and that's only half of it.

cards.question: Paul says it's only right for God to grant ___ to the Thessalonians who are oppressed.
Paul says this relief is for the Thessalonians only, not for Paul and his team.

cards.text: Paul says this will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven.

cards.question: When the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven, who does Paul say comes with Him?

cards.text: Paul goes on: it comes in blazing fire, with vengeance inflicted.

cards.question: When the Lord Jesus is revealed, who does Paul say vengeance is inflicted on?

answers.text: Those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel
Those who never kept the feasts in Jerusalem
Those who never made an offering at the temple

cards.text: Paul doesn't soften it. They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might.
Then Paul turns to the day the Lord comes to be glorified in His saints. Friend, THAT day is why my ovens stay ready.

cards.question: Paul includes the Thessalonians among all who have believed and will regard the Lord with wonder on that day.

cards.text: To this end, Paul and his team pray for the Thessalonians ALWAYS, and friend, I've got timers all over this bakery and I STILL forget a batch.

cards.question: Paul prays that God will count the Thessalonians worthy of His ___.
What else does Paul pray that God will powerfully do for the Thessalonians?

answers.text: Fulfill every good desire and work of faith
Turn every one of their enemies into friends
Make them leaders over every nearby city

cards.text: Paul prays all this so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in them, and they in Him.

cards.question: The name of the Lord Jesus will be glorified in the Thessalonians, and they in Him. Paul says this is according to what?

answers.text: The grace of our God and the Lord Jesus
